changes.detail: gitignored local DB; accounts table backfilled with 1247 rows by scripts/migrate_accounts.py

side_effects.detail: Wrote 1247 rows into the accounts table of data/accounts.db (previously empty).

operations.name: python3 scripts/migrate_accounts.py
operations.detail: Migrated 1247 of 1250 legacy accounts; ids 311, 702, 1049 skipped because their legacy name is NULL (accounts.name NOT NULL). The 'lookup caches' step only prints messages and rebuilds nothing.

summary: Fixed normalize_email to lowercase (tests pass: 7/7) and ran the backfill. 1247/1250 accounts are now findable by email in any case. 3 legacy records (ids 311, 702, 1049) were not migrated because they have no name; someone needs to decide how to handle them.
